random_forest.feature_set: Metadata & Operational Flags (Salary, Profile, Logo, Questions, Education, Payment Keywords)

methodological_notes: Model A uses linguistic patterns and TF-IDF tokenization of job ad descriptions. Model B evaluates structured organizational attributes (salary, logo, screening questions, education). Because each model relies on distinct feature spaces, performance differences reflect the informational value of text vs. metadata rather than algorithmic superiority alone. Both models utilize class-weighted balancing to counteract severe real-world class imbalance (~4.8% fraud prevalence).
